items.title: NT man caught driving 100km/h over speed limit

children.content: Northern Territory Police have charged a man with speeding and high-range drink driving after catching him allegedly driving at more than 100km/h over the limit before returning a blood-alcohol result of 0.153.

items.title: Mother of woman who died in Kakadu takes NT coroner to Supreme Court

children.content: Jessica Stephens's mother Karon Evans has applied for court orders that would force the Northern Territory coroner to hold an inquest into her death in Kakadu National Park after being discharged from Royal Darwin Hospital in 2023.

items.title: On duty just after 6pm, these paramedics' shift is about to go bad

children.content: Two years ago, Alice Springs paramedic Abbey Studley was brutally attacked on the job. Despite a brain injury, she's now back at work — and when the ABC tagged along with ambulance crews, the team recorded its 100th attack for the year.
